b_roll: Aerial view of turbulent waterfall torrents

sections.voiceover: In October 2026, heavy El Nino rains struck Argentina and Brazil. Did Iguazu National Park officials keep the site open during this extreme river surge?
b_roll: Regional map showing the border of Argentina and Brazil
Flooding river waters along the Iguazu River basin

sections.voiceover: But the situation worsened as El Nino pushed the Iguazu Falls flow to 10 times normal.
b_roll: Churning water rapids hitting peak volume at the falls

sections.voiceover: Officials temporarily closed access to Iguazu Falls for safety. Flooding spread across Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay during October 2026. Heavy rains forced thousands of people from their flooded homes.
b_roll: Park entrance signs with temporary closure notice
Map showing flooded regions across Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay
Flooded residential areas across the river basin

sections.voiceover: This massive waterfall complex spans more than a mile across the Brazil and Argentina border.
b_roll: Panoramic view of the Iguazu Falls complex spanning the international border
